title: How Google Astra maps every book on a shelf from one snapshot

Snap a photo of your bookshelf and Google Astra builds a 3D library around it
caption:
Google Astra took one photo of a bookshelf and instantly built a searchable 3D model of every book on it, linked to Goodreads.

No scanning. No typing out titles. Astra read the spines, estimated the depth of each book, and mapped the whole shelf into a 3D space you can actually browse, all from a single snapshot. Something that used to take an afternoon of manual entry now takes one photo.

Each book connects to your Goodreads account directly, showing your rating and reading history right there inside the 3D view.
